notes.title: The Raintime Out Now!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are very happy to announce that [i]The Raintime[/i] 1.0 is out on Steam! 

Getting the game ready was quite a grind, and we are tired at the moment. However, we are glad that we made our Spring 2020 deadline. (Albeit barely.) We hope you enjoy [i]The Raintime[/i]. Please continue providing us with feedback and user experiences.

Best regards,

lain 
S.O.C.A.H.

notes.title: Early Access Update: Full Release Coming Soon
notes.content:
Dear players,

Currently, The Raintime has been in early access for about seven months. During this time, we have been working incessantly towards the full release of the game, which is rapidly nearing finalization. At the moment we have a virtually complete game, and we have moved to playtesting and bugfixing. With this said, we can confidently announce that [b]we're on course to release the full version of The Raintime early June 2020[/b]. We will communicate an exact release date somewhere in the coming weeks. 

Having The Raintime in early access was a great way for us to gather early user feedback. From the different player comments, reviews, and youtube videos that you have posted, we have gathered the most broadly shared points of feedback and criticism, and applied them in game development. Salient edits in the final version of the game include:
[list]
[*] Improved resolution for graphics.
[*] Increased interactivity.
[*] Changes in the storyline and dialogue.
[*] Improved user interface.
[/list]

We are very excited to bring you this news, please stay posted!


lain

S.O.C.A.H.


PS: The Raintime is freeware and will be free even in full release mode.
